## Goal / acceptance criteria
A guard that scans `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` for Windows-unsafe test code: hard-coded '/tmp/...' used as a real filesystem path, string path joins with '/', `os.sep` assumptions, and `Path(...).is_absolute()` used to reject repo-escaping paths without also rejecting a leading '/' (the WO-217 bug). Fake cases prove it flags and passes. List hits in other test folders in VENDOR_STATUS.md only (report, don't fail).

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_windows_path_safety.py`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_windows_path_safety.py`
- `../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/codex`
